title: Galois actions on surfaces and a higher genus Grothendieck-Teichmüller group
summary: We construct a modular operad $\mathbf{S}$ of mapping class groupoids modelling the higher-genus Teichmüller tower, with compositions and contractions encoding surface gluing. We prove a presentation theorem for maps out of $\mathbf{S}$ using genus-zero and genus-one generators and relations. Applying the work of Nakamura--Schneps, we obtain a faithful action of their subgroup $\widehatΓ\subseteq \widehat{\mathsf{GT}}$ on $\widehat{\mathbf{S}}$, and hence a faithful Galois action.
